BiblicalUsage: The Lord shall send upon the disobedient cursing, vexation and rebuke, in all they set their hand to, until they are destroyed and perish quickly, because they have forsaken Him. The word is the reproof itself, the curse that follows forsaking God.
TheologicalSignificance: I take this verse as the plain end of disobedience: cursing, vexation and rebuke, not because God is cruel, but because His people forsook Him.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
